record.question: Which country is known as the Sick Man of Europe?
record.explanation: Answer C: Turkey. ‘Sick Man of Europe’ historically refers to the Ottoman Empire and is commonly applied to Turkey in this country-name question; Turkey is the only fitting listed option. Reference: https://www.britannica.com/topic/Sick-man-of-Europe. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: June 2019 (cover; exact day not printed).
